description: A committed, permanent local example of the ai-3d-factory multi-part assembly workflow: a labeled storage-bin/classroom-supply-bin lid with a friction-fit lip, a separately-colored raised label, and a raised pull tab, all sharing one origin per docs/slicer-review-workflow.md. Hand-authored in OpenSCAD (no built-in generate-openscad template covers a bin-lid shape yet). This is a demo/reference project living under examples/, meant as a practical household/classroom utility baseline for future richer multi-part examples - see examples/storage-bin-lid/README.md.
constraints: Original design only - no franchise/copyrighted logos or characters (see docs/licensing-policy.md).
Demo scale only (160mm x 100mm x 4mm lid panel) - not measured against any real storage bin's actual opening dimensions.
This is a workflow example, not a print order: no STL has been exported, and this example is not slicer_review_ready, human_approved, or print_ready.
